area_note: Metro Cebu: Cebu City, Mandaue and Lapu-Lapu (Mactan Island)
intro: Cebu's everyday running hub is the roughly 1.2km loop around Cebu IT Park, which is busy at 5am and 6pm on weekdays and is often combined with Cebu Business Park for longer routes. Long runs go to the flat, wide roads of the South Road Properties (SRP) near SM Seaside, hill sessions go up the road to Tops in Busay, and track work goes to the Cebu City Sports Center oval. Mandaue runners use the Mandani Bay waterfront, and Mactan runners use the Mactan Newtown area. The scene is built around free community runs and the January Cebu Marathon, which the Cebu Executive Runners Club founded.

clubs.name: Cebu Executive Runners Club (CERC)
clubs.description: A club set up in 1997 by working professionals, which founded and organised the Cebu Marathon. The Freeman reported that for the 10 Jan 2027 edition CERC moves to a consultant role, with the Cebu City Sports Commission and DJT Events organising.
clubs.active_evidence: Organised Cebu Marathon on 11 Jan 2026 (The Freeman, 9 Jan 2026); named as 2027 race consultant (The Freeman, 14 Aug 2026)

clubs.name: Just Show Up Club Cebu

meets.where: Mandani Bay, Mandaue City (meet by LK Bakery on The Boardwalk)

clubs.who: All paces; no tryouts, no pace requirements
clubs.description: The Cebu chapter of the Makati-based Just Show Up Club, with one weekly group run on the Mandani Bay waterfront. The club's website lists the Cebu schedule alongside Manila's.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 17 and 29 Oct 2026; Saturday run listed on the club website, checked 2 Nov 2026

clubs.name: ECYY Community Run
clubs.description: A free community run of 5 to 10km through Cebu City's roads, which The Freeman describes as one of the first to restart group runs in the city after the pandemic, in 2022. The linked Facebook page belongs to ECYY Sports Hub, a running store in Lahug, Cebu City.

clubs.name: RWP Cebu
clubs.cost: Free (per the chapter's Facebook and Instagram descriptions)
clubs.description: The Cebu chapter of the Manila-founded RWP Run Club ('Never run alone'), which holds free weekly group runs. Its Tuesday run is part of the runnr store's weekly club schedule; the 27 Oct 2026 edition started at 6:30pm from the Ayala Center Cebu amphitheatre at The Terraces.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram post of 24 Oct 2026 announcing its Tuesday 27 Oct 2026 run with runnr club; further posts to 30 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Cebu Hash House Harriers

meets.where: Varies around Metro Cebu and nearby provinces (check the club site or Facebook group)

clubs.cost: ₱100 registration; kids free; bring your own drinks
clubs.who: Everyone, including children; most people walk
clubs.description: A weekly social hash on loop trails of about 3.5 to 6.5km in and around Metro Cebu, with regular stops so slower members can catch up. A few hashers run it, but most walk.
clubs.active_evidence: Hash #1563 posted 27 Oct 2026; hashes #1564 to #1566 scheduled for 8, 15 and 22 Nov 2026

coaches.name: Guild of Runners
coaches.offers: One-hour coach-led studio sessions that mix track and treadmill running with strength and conditioning, coaching from 5K to marathon, HYROX running, and an online running programme; free trial class
coaches.where: Studio on N. Escario Street, Cebu City
coaches.credentials: Founder: licensed physical therapist and USATF Level 1 coach
coaches.description: A running-focused fitness studio and community in Cebu City. Its founder is also listed as a coach for runnr club.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 24 Sep to 30 Oct 2026; studio covered in a Keeta guide to Cebu's running community, 30 Jul 2026
